attributes.board_name: Oklahoma State Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses/meetings offered or approved by AVMA, AAVSB (RACE — no limit on RACE online CE), Oklahoma State University CVM, other state veterinary boards or recognized state veterinary associations; other providers need Board approval; interactive online courses must be RACE-approved or offered by OSU CVM
rules.new_licensee_rule: Graduates licensed within one calendar year of graduation report CE starting with the second renewal after licensure.
rules.audit_note: Certificates not sent with renewal; keep proof 5 years for random audit.

topics.who: All: state or federal controlled dangerous substance laws, or review of the Oklahoma Veterinary Practice Act and rules (board meeting attendance also counts)
DEA registrants: pain management or opioid use/addiction

rules.notes: 20 hours per renewal year July 1–June 30. Max 4 h each for presentations/publications, autotutorial/web-based material, and journal reading; non-scientific topics max 25%.
